lessons_used: Reordering sign-in after pet or companion selection worked, whereas reordering sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Targeted sign-in security and persistence hints, along with path duration and persistence hints, frequently worked, though several hints showed no clear effect or hurt.

Personality-driven headlines, headline refreshes, and live generation countdown timers worked, but general story copy, photo quality guidance, and time headlines either hurt or showed no clear effect.

Select layout redesigns and tutorial screens worked (such as the photo upload split layout and desktop tray guide screen), whereas sub-flows, trait selectors, and flow bypasses either hurt or showed no clear effect.
Notifications, audio chimes, wait-screen activity tips, badges, and incentives showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains for sub-flows, story copy, and post-photo sign-in reordering, while underestimating gains for targeted headlines, live timers, and specific guide or layout updates.

candidates.title: Desktop pet status verification screen
candidates.change: Adds a post-generation verification step that confirms the companion successfully rendered on the desktop before completing setup.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pets failing to show on the desktop or the app failing to open after the waiting step.

new_desktop_verify.headline: Desktop Pet Verification
new_desktop_verify.body: Checking that your companion loaded properly on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a verification screen inside onboarding is allowed and preserves all required steps.

candidates.score_note: Extra verification sub-flows and post-generation steps historically hurt or show no gain.

candidates.title: Split layout companion photo selection stage
candidates.change: Redesigns photo selection into a split layout combining interactive preview frame with photo picker controls.
candidates.why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and previous split layout changes proved effective.

guard.reason: 'upload_photos.replace.photo_upload[1]': a preview cannot do the photo_upload job (use ['button', 'checklist', 'image', 'photo_picker', 'text'])

candidates.title: Dual path choice split destination flow
candidates.change: Rebuilds path selection into a dual-column layout comparing instant preset adoption with custom photo creation.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a long mean time of 514s, showing users struggle to compare journey options.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Spotlight stage finish welcome redesign
candidates.change: Rebuilds the final onboarding screen into a spotlight stage layout emphasizing active companion status.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is 23.7% and multiple users were confused about pet controls immediately after onboarding.

home_welcome.text: Your companion is active on your desktop screen

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro welcome screen layout inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Finish step has high drop-off, but finish redesigns previously dropped conversion by 3.9%.

candidates.title: Existing pet sign-in safety hint
candidates.change: Displays an explicit hint on the sign-in screen reassuring users that logging in preserves existing pet data.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top issue) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Sign in to securely sync your pets and keep your desktop companions saved.

guard.reason: Adding a sign-in data safety hint is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Top support complaint backed by strong evidence; targeted sign-in persistence hints reliably work.

candidates.title: Generation system status progress info
candidates.change: Adds active background system status text alongside the live timer during pet generation.
candidates.why: The home waiting step has a high mean duration of 2336s, causing user drop-off.

waiting.hint: Generating companion graphics... your desktop pet will appear shortly.

guard.reason: Adding status progress info and timer to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean wait times on home step; wait info updates consistently perform well (+1.5%).

candidates.title: Path selection journey headline update
candidates.change: Updates the story headline to highlight fast path selection clarity.
candidates.why: Learnings show targeted headline refreshes improve early funnel speed and conversion.

story.headline: Choose Your Desktop Companion Journey Path

guard.reason: Updating story headline text within onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Story copy changes at path selection historically underperformed (-1.6% across 6 tests).

candidates.title: Photo processing optimization hint
candidates.change: Displays a hint during photo upload reassuring users that uploaded photos are automatically optimized.
candidates.why: Support received multiple complaints about custom pet generation output looking unexpected.

upload_photos.hint: Uploaded photos are automatically optimized for desktop rendering.

guard.reason: Adding an optimization hint to photo upload within onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targeted at adoption drop-off, but photo quality guidance hints showed no clear positive effect.

candidates.title: Background generation ready desktop alert
candidates.change: Enables a desktop notification option when companion generation completes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Users face high mean wait times (2336s) and lose context while waiting for pet creation.

guard.reason: Enabling desktop ready notifications on the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: High wait times justify intervention, but notification experiments previously showed minimal effect.

candidates.title: Tray navigation guide final screen
candidates.change: Adds a new end-of-flow screen showing users how to control and hide the desktop pet via the system tray.
candidates.why: 3 support emails indicated confusion about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.

new_tray_guide.headline: Desktop Tray Companion Controls
new_tray_guide.body: Use the menu bar icon to toggle visibility or interact with your companion anytime.

guard.reason: Adding a new guidance screen following home intro is explicitly allowed by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Tray guide screens explicitly proven effective in prior lessons; finish new screens average +0.9%.

lessons_next: Reordering sign-in after pet or companion selection worked, whereas reordering sign-in after photo upload hurt performance.
Targeted sign-in security and persistence hints, path duration hints, and photo processing hints won, while many other hints had no clear effect or hurt.
Personality-driven headlines, headline refreshes, and live countdown timers won, whereas general story copy, time headlines, and photo quality guidance hurt or showed no clear effect.
Specific layout redesigns and tutorial screens (such as photo upload split layout and tray guide screen) won, while sub-flows, trait selectors, and most flow bypasses hurt or showed no clear effect.
Notifications, audio chimes, wait-screen activity tips, badges, and incentives showed no clear effect.
Predictions overestimated gains for sub-flows, story copy, and post-photo sign-in reordering, while underestimating gains for targeted headlines, live timers, specific guide screens, and photo hints.
